term: mathematical knowledge, causal connection and God-like provider in #118
definition: The presentation asserts strongly certain mathematical beliefs and knowledge, imposes a causal explanation between knower and object known, and restricts possible providers of the belief explanation to God-like beings. The final existence conclusion uses these separate commitments.
note: Knowledge of proposition p and relation to an object, connection existence and actual provider, certainty and knowledge, and causal explanation versus Ontic causation are distinct. God-like has no specified classical or positivity signature; no concrete/necessary/unique bearer dictionary is introduced.
